answer:
Hypothesis (data-grounded): In the survey of ML-enabled system projects, the two LEAST used documentation formats for requirements are **ML Canvas** and **BDD Scenarios** — respectively reported as 10.13% (95% CI [9.926, 10.333]) and 4.366% (95% CI [4.231, 4.501]) of respondents indicating so, in that order ("10.13% → ML Canvas, 4.366% → BDD Scenarios").

Data grounding (this CSV, verification pass): among the 194 valid Q10 respondents (the 82 non-responders — all Suspended, encoded '-77' — were excluded as NA), 'quoted' mentions per format rank ML Canvas (n=15, ~7.73%) second-lowest and BDD Scenarios (n=4, ~2.06%) absolutely lowest; all other named formats have ≥29 mentions (Vision Document 29, Goal Models 29, Data Models 34, Use Case Models 38, Prototypes 42, Requirements Lists 51, User Stories 63, Notebooks 66). The bottom two are therefore unambiguous. The non-named options 'Others' (n=15, free-text category) and 'Not_Documented' (n=30, absence option "aspects are not documented") were excluded from the least-used-format ranking per the analysis plan.

Supporting context (computed here): own bootstrap (10,000 iterations, seed=42, resampling the 194 respondents, percentile 95% CI) gives ML Canvas 7.732% CI [4.124, 11.856] and BDD Scenarios 2.062% CI [0.515, 4.124]. These computed-here estimates differ from the question's anchor percentages (10.13%, 4.366%) and their far tighter CIs because the original analysis used a different bootstrap unit/sample that is not reproducible from this CSV (a per-respondent proportion bootstrap on these 276 rows cannot yield CIs that tight). This is the single unresolved assumption; it does not affect the identification of the two least-used formats, which is driven by the ranking.

payload.hypothesis: The two least-used documentation formats for requirements in ML-enabled system projects are ML Canvas (question anchor 10.13%, 95% CI [9.926, 10.333]; computed here 7.73%) and BDD Scenarios (question anchor 4.366%, 95% CI [4.231, 4.501]; computed here 2.06%), respectively. Among the 194 valid Q10 responders, ML Canvas has 15 'quoted' mentions and BDD Scenarios has 4 (the lowest); all other named formats have >=29 mentions.
payload.workflow: 1) Loaded requirements_engineering_for_ML-enabled_systems.csv (276x202). 2) Q10 matrix columns carry 3 values: 'quoted', 'not quoted', '-77'; the identical 82 '-77' rows (all Status=Suspended) are NA for Q10 -> excluded. 3) Base = 194 valid Q10 responders; 'quoted'=use indicator. 4) Tallied mentions per format and ranked. 5) Excluded non-named options 'Others' and 'Not_Documented' from the least-used-format answer. 6) Computed point estimates (% of 194) and bootstrap 95% percentile CIs (10,000 iters, seed=42, resample 194 respondents). 7) Mapped the question's anchors by ordering: 10.13% -> ML Canvas, 4.366% -> BDD Scenarios.
